note: Real digests for version 0.2.0, built from the plugin repository's main branch at commit faefea4c284a (make release-with-prebuilt-fpp10 VERSION=0.2.0). This version adds pairing by code, brightness reporting and the brightness ceiling, and reports a finished show as a stop. Those exact artifacts are published as the v0.2.0 pre-release on ShowMeshSystems/showmesh-fpp-plugin, the default artifact host. Regenerate this file from the manifest whenever a new release is cut; there is no tooling that does it automatically. The three native-prebuilt-fpp10 objects were built once each against FPP 10.0 (370e62ed7e8c) on an Apple Silicon Mac under Docker Desktop; no second host has rebuilt and compared them.
